versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֗ר תּוֹלָ֧ע וּפוּאָ֛ה ישיב וְשִׁמְר֖וֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
controles.kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Issacar foram quatro: Tolá, Pua, Jasube, e Sinrom.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹלָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּרְפָיָ֡ה וִֽ֠ירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַ֨י וְיִבְשָׂ֜ם וּשְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אֲבוֹתָם֙ לְתוֹלָ֔ע גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם מִסְפָּרָם֙ בִּימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Tolá foram: Uzi, Refaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsão e Samuel, cabeças das famílias de seus pais. De Tolá foram contados por suas genealogias no tempo de Davi vinte e dois mil seiscentos homens guerreiros.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠עֹבַדְיָה וְיוֹאֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
controles.livre: O filho de Uzi foi Izraías; e os filhos de Izraías foram: Micael, Obadias, Joel, e Issias; todos estes cinco foram líderes.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֜ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֗ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּֽי־הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּבָנִֽים׃

controles.web: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
controles.kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
controles.livre: E havia com eles em suas genealogias, segundo as famílias de seus pais, trinta e seis mil homens de guerra, porque tiveram muitas mulheres e filhos.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם לְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשָׂשכָ֔ר גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמוֹנִ֤ים וְשִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לַכֹּֽל׃פ

controles.web: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
controles.kjv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos em todas as famílias de Issacar, todos contados por suas genealogias, foram oitenta e sete mil guerreiros valentes.

versos.hebraico: בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֧לַע וָבֶ֛כֶר וִידִֽיעֲאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
controles.kjv: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Benjamim foram três: Belá, Bequer, e Jediael.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבּ֡וֹן וְעֻזִּ֡י וְ֠עֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימ֨וֹת וְעִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Belá foram: Esbom, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimote, e Iri; cinco cabeças de famílias paternas, guerreiros valentes, dos quais foram contados por suas genealogias vinte e dois mil e trinta e quatro.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְיוֹעָ֡שׁ וֶ֠אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י וְעָמְרִי֙ וִירֵמ֣וֹת וַאֲבִיָּ֔ה וַעֲנָת֖וֹת וְעָלָ֑מֶת כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־בָֽכֶר׃

controles.web: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Bequer: Zemira, Joás, Eliézer, Elioenai, Onri, Jerimote, Abias, Anatote e Alemete; todos estes foram filhos de Bequer.

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֗ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: They were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: E foram contados por suas genealogias, segundo suas descendências, e os cabeças de suas famílias, vinte mil e duzentos guerreiros valentes.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן יעיש וּ֠בִנְיָמִן וְאֵה֤וּד וּֽכְנַעֲנָה֙ וְזֵיתָ֔ן וְתַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַאֲחִישָֽׁחַר׃

controles.web: The sons of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
controles.kjv: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
controles.livre: E o filho de Jediael foi Bilã; e os filhos de Bilã foram: Jeús, Benjamim, Eúde, Quenaaná, Zetã, Társis, e Aisaar.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּמָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
controles.kjv: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
controles.livre: Todos estes filhos de Jediael foram cabeças de famílias, guerreiros valentes, dezessete mil e duzentos que saíam com o exército para a guerra.

versos.hebraico: וְשֻׁפִּ֤ם וְחֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.
controles.kjv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
controles.livre: Supim e Hupim foram filhos de Ir; e Husim foi filho de Aer.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְגוּנִ֛י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
controles.kjv: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Naftali foram: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer, e Salum, filhos de Bila.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת־מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃

controles.web: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore: she bore Machir the father of Gilead:
controles.kjv: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Manassés foram: Asriel, o qual foi nascido de sua concubina, a síria, a qual também lhe deu à luz Maquir, pai de Gileade.

versos.hebraico: וּמָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְחֻפִּ֣ים וּלְשֻׁפִּ֔ים וְשֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹתוֹ֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י צְלָפְחָ֑ד וַתִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִצְלָפְחָ֖ד בָּנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
controles.kjv: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
controles.livre: E Maquir tomou por mulher a irmã de Hupim e Supim, cuja irmã teve por nome Maaca. O nome do segundo foi Zelofeade. E Zelofeade teve somente filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּבָנָ֖יו אוּלָ֥ם וָרָֽקֶם׃

controles.web: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
controles.kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
controles.livre: E Maaca mulher de Maquir lhe gerou um filho, e chamou seu nome Perez; e o nome de seu irmão foi Seres, cujos filhos foram Ulão e Requém.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן־מָכִ֖יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

controles.web: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
controles.livre: E o filho de Ulão foi Bedã. Estes foram os filhos de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֹת֖וֹ הַמֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָלְדָה֙ אֶת־אִישְׁה֔וֹד וְאֶת־אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מַחְלָֽה׃

controles.web: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
controles.kjv: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
controles.livre: E sua irmã Hamolequete deu à luz Isode, Abiezer, e Maalá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָשֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִקְחִ֖י וַאֲנִיעָֽם׃פ

controles.web: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Semida foram Aiã, Siquém, Liqui, e Anião.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּבֶ֤רֶד בְּנוֹ֙ וְתַ֣חַת בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Efraim: Sutela, seu filho Berede, seu filho Taate, seu filho Eleada, seu filho Taate,

versos.hebraico: וְזָבָ֥ד בְּנ֛וֹ וְשׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְעֵ֣זֶר וְאֶלְעָ֑ד וַהֲרָג֗וּם אַנְשֵׁי־גַת֙ הַנּוֹלָדִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָרְד֔וּ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
controles.kjv: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
controles.livre: Seu filho Zabade, seu filho Sutela, seu filho, Ézer, e Eleade. Mas os homens de Gate, naturais daquela terra, os mataram, porque desceram para tomar seus gados.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִיהֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖יו לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
controles.kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
controles.livre: Por isso seu pai Efraim esteve de luto por muitos dias, e seus irmãos vieram consolá-lo.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמוֹ֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְרָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
controles.kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
controles.livre: Depois ele se deitou com sua mulher, ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, ao qual chamou por nome Berias, pois o desastre havia ocorrido em sua casa.

versos.hebraico: וּבִתּ֣וֹ שֶׁאֱרָ֔ה וַתִּ֧בֶן אֶת־בֵּית־חוֹר֛וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃

controles.web: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
controles.kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth–horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen–sherah.)
controles.livre: E sua filha foi Seerá, a qual edificou a Bete-Horom, a baixa e a alta, como também a Uzém-Seerá.

versos.hebraico: וְרֶ֣פַח בְּנ֗וֹ וְרֶ֧שֶׁף וְתֶ֛לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַן בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
controles.kjv: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
controles.livre: E seu filho foi Refa, seu filho Resefe, seu filho Telá, seu filho Taã,

versos.hebraico: לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנ֛וֹ עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנ֖וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
controles.kjv: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
controles.livre: Seu filho Laadã, seu filho Amiúde, seu filho Elisama,

versos.hebraico: נ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
controles.kjv: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
controles.livre: Seu filho Num, e seu filho Josué.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם֙ וּמֹ֣שְׁבוֹתָ֔ם בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלַמִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְלַֽמַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּבְנֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ וּשְׁכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ עַד־עַיָּ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Their possessions and habitations were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
controles.kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Beth–el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
controles.livre: E a propriedade e habitação deles foi Betel com suas aldeias, e ao oriente Naarã, e ao ocidente Gezer e suas aldeias, como também Siquém com suas aldeias, até Aia e suas aldeias;

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־יְדֵ֣י בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית־שְׁאָ֤ן וּבְנֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ מְגִדּ֥וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ דּ֣וֹר וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בְּאֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
controles.kjv: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth–shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
controles.livre: E da parte dos filhos de Manassés, Bete-Seã com suas aldeias, Taanaque com suas aldeias, Megido com suas aldeias, e Dor com suas aldeias. Nestes lugares habitaram os filhos de José, filho de Israel.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֥רַח אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
controles.kjv: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Aser foram: Imná, Isvá, Isvi, Berias, e sua irmã Sera.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י ברזות׃

controles.web: The sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Berias foram: Héber, e Malquiel, o qual foi pai de Bizarvite.

versos.hebraico: וְחֶ֨בֶר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַפְלֵ֔ט וְאֶת־שׁוֹמֵ֖ר וְאֶת־חוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Heber became the father of Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
controles.kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
controles.livre: E Héber gerou a Jaflete, Semer, Hotão, e sua irmã Suá.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּבִמְהָ֖ל וְעַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט׃

controles.web: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jaflete foram: Pasaque, Bimal, e Asvate. Estes foram os filhos de Jaflete.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י ורוהגה יחבה וַאֲרָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Semer foram: Aí, Roga, Jeubá, e Arã.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑יו צוֹפַ֥ח וְיִמְנָ֖ע וְשֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
controles.kjv: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
controles.livre: Os filhos de seu irmão Helém foram: Zofa, Imná, Seles, e Amal.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י צוֹפָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְחַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְשׁוּעָ֖ל וּבֵרִ֥י וְיִמְרָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
controles.kjv: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Zofa foram: Suá, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Inra,

versos.hebraico: בֶּ֣צֶר וָה֗וֹד וְשַׁמָּ֧א וְשִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְיִתְרָ֖ן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃

controles.web: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
controles.kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
controles.livre: Bezer, Hode, Samá, Silsa, Iltrã e Beera.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י יֶ֑תֶר יְפֻנֶּ֥ה וּפִסְפָּ֖ה וַאְרָֽא׃

controles.web: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jéter foram: Jefoné, Pispa, e Ara.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְחַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְרִצְיָֽא׃

controles.web: The sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Ula foram; Ara, Haniel, e Rizia.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית־הָאָב֤וֹת בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ם בַּצָּבָא֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

controles.web: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
controles.kjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
controles.livre: Todos estes foram filhos de Aser, cabeças de famílias paternas, escolhidos guerreiros valentes, chefes de príncipes; e foram contados em suas genealogias no exército para a guerra, em número de vinte e seis mil homens.
